entities.summary: Cassius Felix, also Cassius Felix of Cirta, was a Roman African medical writer probably native of Constantina. He is known for having written in AD 447 a Latin treatise titled De Medicina - although the exact date is transmitted only in a relatively late manuscript from the 13th century.
